title: Product overview — exploration A
summary: Exploration A, a dashboard with a right rail: the main column holds the one attention item and an Integration checklist (one row per feature with its own platform marks, the first open step as the page's one primary); the rail holds the six features' facts and recent activity.
compare: Header: DJDL's logo, name and slug, the identity line only ('A DJ app for macOS and Windows'; licenses and devices are counted where they live), a More menu and 'Continue integration' as the one primary. Once Integration is hidden, the primary becomes the first enabled feature's main action.

Needs attention shows only DJDL's broken things from the same server read as Home, each naming its feature, not the product, in the same words as Home: 'Required secret identity.acoustidKey has no value in the Default profile.' The count sits 8px after the title.
The Integration card replaces Welcome, the Trust & SDK panel and the setup checklist; none of them appears anywhere on the page.

Integration card head: only 'Integration', at the block step (18/24): no sentence, no icon tile, no menu. The counts sit in the platform column headers: 'macOS' with '2 of 5' on the right and a 4px bar under them at the column's width (a 56px header row); Windows, planned but never seen, shows only its name. No band of meters above the table. The card has no Continue or 'Open Integration' of its own while the page primary is Continue integration.

The card's grid has one row per enabled feature in canonical order (Commerce is off, so no row) and the columns Feature, In the console, In your app, macOS, Windows (colgroup 22/19/23/20/16%). 'In the console' is Done, or the open ring with the step as one verb link on one line ('Add Sparkle signing key', 'Set storage per account'; with two or more steps: '2 steps: Sparkle signing key, …'). Rows are 56px.

In your app (owner, 2026-10-08): every feature leads with the drop-in path, 'Drop-in kit' (to that feature on Integration, where the generated kit code, the fewest lines that give working screens, comes first), then 'Your own UI ↗' to that SDK's docs for integrating directly on the library (aria-label 'Integrate <feature> directly with your own UI: Swift SDK docs'). No library walkthrough appears on Overview.

Verified has four states, defined once and drawn the same on Overview and Integration: Verified (green tick, then the time only, 'Oct 7, 10:42'; the SDK version only when it differs from the foot's latest sighting) once the console steps are done and the SDK's call succeeded; 'Waiting for the first …' (a neutral clock, never the accent) when the console steps are done and the platform has been seen, but not this feature's call yet; 'After the console step' (muted, open ring, never a link) when the platform has been seen but a console step is still open; 'Not seen yet' (dashed ring) when no SDK has reached Polaris Key from that platform. While no SDK has reached Polaris Key from Windows, the Windows column is one top-aligned cell spanning the five rows: 'Not seen yet' and, under it, 'Add the SDK', which opens Integration's SDK picker with Windows selected. A long state wraps and hangs past its glyph; nothing runs into the next column. Healthy states are status text, never pills.

Ship builds shows its CI fact ('First CI publish Oct 6') under its name, because CI sends no SDK request and Ship builds isn't counted in '2 of 5'. Its macOS cell reads 'After the console step' until the Sparkle signing key exists, then waits for the updater's first check. Cloud Sync's macOS cell also reads 'After the console step' (storage per account), although the Swift SDK has reached Polaris Key from macOS.

The foot is muted, with the code glyph: 'Last seen 4 min ago · Swift SDK 2.1.0'. On its right a ghost 'Hide' (eye-off, aria-label 'Hide Integration'), offered because macOS has a Verified feature and never automatic: the same visible control products.integration uses. No 'Open Integration'.

Features is a card: 'Features' at the block step with 'Manage features →' (Settings → Features) on the right, and the five features as cells of one strip inside it, in canonical order. Each cell links to its feature's home (the label's link stretches over the cell, with a hover fill and the focus ring on the cell): Licensing '240 licenses', 'Standard · 3 waiting'; Managed config 'v4 catalog', '12 settings · 3 secrets', with the warning dot on its glyph and aria-label 'Managed config: 1 needs attention' (the problem itself is in Needs attention, not repeated); Ship builds '4.2.0 stable', '4.3.0-beta.2 on beta · Oct 6'; Sign-in '312 accounts', 'Pocket ID · members, admins'; Cloud Sync 'Not syncing yet' and no foot. A short last row fills the width; at 1024 the five cells sit in one row.
No signing key, JWKS URL or SDK chooser on Overview: the key lives on Keys & secrets, the SDK on Integration.

Phone: More (⋯) ends the title row and Continue integration takes the full-width action row alone. The Integration card shows, under its head, the macOS meter ('macOS · 2 of 5' and its bar) and one line 'Windows · Not seen yet · Add the SDK', with no per-feature Windows lines. Each feature stacks its name, then a 'Console', an 'App' and a 'macOS' line, each led by its label in one 80px label column so the values share one edge. Features become 56px rows: glyph and name on the left, value on the right, the foot under the name. Activity times sit 4px under their text in every row, and example-org/djdl never breaks.

The DJDL sidebar shows one count, on Devices (412, ST-36's device pill), as on every product screen; feature groups are muted sentence-case labels (buttons with aria-expanded) whose 2px service bar is the only colour. At tablet the sidebar is the 56px icon rail, each feature group drawn as its service glyph.
Continue integration lands on Integration, scrolled to the first open item in canonical order: Ship builds › Sparkle signing key.

Wide (1600 and up): the main column (1184px at 1920) holds Needs attention, Integration and Features (five cells of about 236px); Recent activity is the 400px aside beside them, its rows wrapping with the time 4px under the text. Tablet (1024): the 56px rail leaves 920px; with the colgroup and wrapping states every Integration row stays 56px and no state runs into the next column. Below 1600 the order is unchanged.
Recent activity names the product's events without naming the product: 'Mara Fennick activated a MacBook Pro', 'Tomás Okafor joined as editor'.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.
Superseded: the guide's p252 draws this exploration; products.overview (B board + C steps) is the one built (admin-1-17).

designReview.reviewer: Lead product designer, deciding on five UX reviews (UX1 spacing, UX2 content, UX3 flow, UX4 accessibility and responsive, UX5 first-time operator)
designReview.verdict: Applied: four sizes (56px rail at tablet, main + Recent activity aside at wide), counts in the platform headers, one merged Windows cell, one verb link per open step, 'After the console step', a Features card with a stat strip, terse copy, and the drop-in path first for each feature. Declined items keep content and states for a later states pass or follow ST-40/41/45 and owner rules.

findings.issue: The header line '· 240 licenses · 412 devices' repeated the Licensing tile and the sidebar's Devices count; on phone 'devices' sat alone on line 2.
findings.resolution: page-sub is the identity line only: 'A DJ app for macOS and Windows'.

findings.issue: On phone the bare ⋯ sat before the primary, where the thumb reached it first.
findings.resolution: Kit phone header: ⋯ More ends the title row; Continue integration takes the full-width row alone.

findings.issue: The far-right attention count read as a stray badge; the row opened with a filler 'The'.
findings.resolution: Count beside the title (kit). Row: 'Required secret identity.acoustidKey has no value in the Default profile.', the same as Home.

findings.issue: The Integration head restated the meters and grid, hid its only action in a one-item menu, the foot described the mechanism, and three routes led to Integration.
findings.resolution: Head is only 'Integration' at the block step (sentence, plug tile and menu deleted). Foot: muted code glyph, 'Last seen 4 min ago · Swift SDK 2.1.0 on macOS arm64', and a ghost 'Hide' (eye-off) on the right. 'Open Integration' removed; the page primary goes there.

findings.issue: The Windows meter sat over the macOS column at every size; platform names appeared twice within 60px; equal columns overflowed at 1024.
findings.resolution: The 66px meter band is gone. macOS's header holds its name, '2 of 5' and a 4px bar (kit .meter-head, 56px header row); Windows shows its name only. The table has a colgroup instead of equal columns (22/19/23/20/16% with the In your app column below).

findings.issue: 'Windows not seen' was said 7–8 times and the largest open job had no action.
findings.resolution: The Windows column is one top-aligned cell spanning the five rows (td rowspan=5): 'Not seen yet' and, under it, 'Add the SDK' (Integration's SDK picker with Windows selected).

findings.issue: Each open step was linked twice per row in two looks; two identical 'Finish the console step' links went to different places (WCAG 2.4.9); 'Finish…' read as a command.
findings.resolution: The console cell is the open ring and one verb link on one line ('Add Sparkle signing key', 'Set storage per account'; kit .open-step). The macOS cell is a muted, non-link 'After the console step' (kit .after-step, the old .finish-step renamed). Rows are back to 56px.

findings.issue: 'Swift 2.1.0' appeared three times; 'A test license is optional' changed nothing and wrapped rows to 69px; 'CI verified' clashed with the SDK meaning of Verified.
findings.resolution: Verified meta is the time only ('Oct 7, 10:42'). The test-license hint is gone. Ship builds' sub-line reads 'First CI publish Oct 6'.

findings.issue: On phone 'Done' floated unlabelled under the feature name, 'Windows · Not seen yet' repeated five times, and the card was 1,156px tall.
findings.resolution: Phone (kit narrow-card rules): under the head, the macOS meter and one line 'Windows · Not seen yet · Add the SDK' (.show-narrow); the merged Windows cell hides (.hide-narrow). Each feature stacks its name, then 'Console', 'App' and 'macOS' lines with labels in one 80px column. Stacked lines sit 4px apart, 8px under the feature name. Measured 969px: the per-feature 'App' line (the owner's 2026-10-08 drop-in direction) adds about 140px, so the 600px target isn't met; every line the triage named is gone.

findings.issue: Features, the least urgent block, had the loudest heading and five separate boxes; feet repeated the attention row and the Integration step; tiles went 3 + 2 at tablet; tiles looked static.
findings.resolution: Features is a card: 'Features' at the block step with 'Manage features →'; the cells are one .stats.strip (kit), each a stretched link with a hover fill. Copy: 'Standard · 3 waiting'; Managed config '12 settings · 3 secrets' with the warning dot on its glyph and aria-label 'Managed config: 1 needs attention'; Cloud Sync 'Not syncing yet' with no foot. Five cells in one row at 1024; 56px rows on phone.

findings.issue: Activity rows named the product on its own page; on phone the time gap jumped between 4 and 12px and 'example-org/djdl' broke at its hyphen.
findings.resolution: 'Mara Fennick activated a MacBook Pro (macOS 15.1, Standard)', 'Tomás Okafor joined as editor'. Narrow list rows (kit): the media spans both lines, the time sits 4px under the text, mono paths don't break.

findings.issue: At 1920 'Set secret' sat 721px from its sentence, activity times 990–1,220px from their text, and platform columns were 404px wide for 170px of content.
findings.resolution: The page is .page.columns: the main column (1184px at 1920) holds Needs attention, Integration and Features; Recent activity is the 400px aside (.aside.span-3) with stacked list rows. Below 1600 the order is unchanged.

findings.issue: At 1024 'Waiting for the first sign-in' ran into the Windows ring, 'Finish the console step' and 'Managed config' overflowed, the meta wrapped mid-value and rows grew to 69px; the attention sentence was cut.
findings.resolution: The 56px rail leaves 920px; with the colgroup, the wrapping Verified states (kit) and the cell cuts every row measures 56–57px and no state crosses its column. The attention sentence shows in full.

findings.issue: Compare contradicted the kit (an accent dot with a halo for Waiting), required the meter band being removed, and never said where Continue integration lands.
findings.resolution: Compare rewritten for items 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 11, plus new items: In your app, where Continue integration lands (Integration, scrolled to Ship builds › Sparkle signing key), wide and tablet, and the activity copy.

findings.issue: Owner direction (2026-10-08): the console offers the drop-in path and links to the docs for integrating directly on the library with your own UI; the Overview's Integration card leads each feature with the drop-in UI kit and gives each a clear link to integrate directly.
findings.resolution: New 'In your app' column, as on Integration's feature cards: 'Drop-in kit' (to that feature on Integration, where the kit code leads) and a quieter 'Your own UI ↗' to the Swift SDK docs (aria-label 'Integrate <feature> directly with your own UI: Swift SDK docs'), side by side so rows stay 56px; an 'App' line on phone. No code or walkthrough on Overview.

findings.issue: States boards: not started, all verified, attention error, a viewer who can't set secrets, empty activity, loading, Integration hidden with a toast.
findings.resolution: Declined: New content and states; queued for a states pass on the new system.

findings.issue: Glyph-only attention pills, or icon-only below 1100px.
findings.resolution: Declined: Owner rule: issues are pills. Wrapping removes the truncation.

findings.issue: Move page-level titles out of the cards, or set them to 20/28.
findings.resolution: Declined: One 18/24 block step inside the card heads (EXPERIENCE §3).

findings.issue: Move Needs attention into the wide rail.
findings.resolution: Declined: It is the page's most urgent block and must read first in the main column; the aside takes Recent activity.

findings.issue: Remove the slug beside the h1.
findings.resolution: Declined: It is the identity people copy; ST-45 specifies it.

findings.issue: Rename the Verified vocabulary ('No calls yet', 'Console setup', 'macOS app') and add a legend tooltip.
findings.resolution: Declined: ST-40/41 and glossary terms shared with Integration; a legend adds text. Only 'After the console step' was taken.

findings.issue: Draw the platform cell under an open console step as an en dash, 'Console step first', or the old words without the link.
findings.resolution: Declined: An en dash says nothing; unlinked 'Finish the console step' reads as a broken link. 'After the console step' reads as a state.

findings.issue: Cut the Sign-in foot to 'Pocket ID'; change Ship builds' foot to 'Beta: 4.3.0-beta.2 · Oct 6'.
findings.resolution: Declined: 'members, admins' appears nowhere else on the page, so it is information; Ship builds' foot repeats nothing.

findings.issue: 'activated a MacBook Pro (Standard)', dropping macOS 15.1.
findings.resolution: Declined: That drops information; only the repeated product name is cut.

findings.issue: A chevron on each Features tile.
findings.resolution: Declined: Five more glyphs; each cell is a link with a hover fill instead.

findings.issue: A six-column :has() rule for five tiles.
findings.resolution: Declined: Superseded by the strip and the fill-the-last-row rule.

findings.issue: A 64px rail or other rail breakpoints.
findings.resolution: Declined: The built console's AppShell starts a 56px rail at 1024–1279.

previousRounds.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
previousRounds.verdict: Fixed: the Verified states now follow one four-state definition shared with Integration, the duplicate Continue is gone, and progress is counted per platform.

findings.issue: Verified states contradicted each other: Ship builds had '1 step left' yet macOS said 'Waiting for the first update check'; Cloud Sync had '1 step left' yet macOS said 'Not seen yet' although the Swift SDK had reached Polaris Key from macOS.
findings.resolution: Four states defined once (Verified; Waiting for the first …; Finish the console step; Not seen yet) and written into compare. Ship builds macOS and Cloud Sync macOS now read 'Finish the console step' (muted, open ring, a link to the step). Waiting is used only where the console is done (Sign-in on macOS).

findings.issue: The header's Continue integration and the card's outline Continue went to the same place; '2 of 5 verified' didn't say which platform; '1 step left' had no mark.
findings.resolution: The card's Continue is removed (only its More menu stays). The meter is one bar per platform: macOS 2 of 5, Windows 0 of 5. '1 step left:' has an open-ring mark and names its step as a link.

findings.issue: '3 waiting for an email' instead of the glossary's waiting licenses; on phone Cloud Sync's tile sat alone in a half-empty last row.
findings.resolution: Tile reads 'Standard · 3 waiting licenses'. On phone an odd last tile spans both columns.

findings.issue: Cross-screen (from sidebar-contexts): this sidebar had no counts while the Sidebar contexts board showed Devices 412 and Licenses 240.
findings.resolution: One rule everywhere: Devices carries the device count (ST-36's pill) and nothing else does. Devices 412 added here.
